test_title: PYST 18: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Refer to the following series and answer the question (all numbers are single-digit numbers only). (Counting to be done from left to right only.)

(Left) 1 4 6 7 3 8 5 3 2 1 5 9 6 6 6 6 8 7 1 6 6 3 1 (Right)

How many such odd digits are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit?
solution:
**Given: **(Left) 1 4 6 7 3 8 5 3 2 1 5 9 6 6 6 6 8 7 1 6 6 3 1 (Right)

Now,

Odd digits, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit.

So, the needed pattern is: Odd — Odd — Odd

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83266d2acb4a0880c62c5b99ed7cd5961c528fd4b77b4843c29baf17b4319ba2.png] 

 

Thus, there is one odd digit, which is immediately preceded by an odd digit and also immediately followed by an odd digit.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
